scientific_question: Does the strongest calibrated family continue improving on the 26,624/6,656 pilot bank when given further 20-epoch segments, and does the ordering between families survive being given comparable numbers of epochs?
declared_by: project owner, 2026-08-05: continue lr3e4 for another 20 epochs; if the best loss is within 6 epochs of the most current epoch continue, otherwise move to lr1e4_halfbatch on the same rule, then lr3e5
boundary: Optimization evidence on the pilot bank only. Establishes nothing about Geant4 fidelity, three-seed behaviour, or untouched-test performance. The 76,300-event test split stays sealed and is not read by training, diagnostics, or visualization.
improvement_rule: after a segment, continue the same family when latest_epoch - best_epoch <= improvement_window, otherwise advance to the next family in the chain
patience_rule: early_stopping_patience equals the segment horizon. A constant patience counts staleness against an inherited best reached at the end of an anneal and stopped dicos-p8 at 6 of 24 epochs.
scheduler_rule: restart_scheduler_on_resume is false. CosineAnnealingLR is periodic in 2*T_max, so a continued cosine climbs back toward peak by itself; that produced dicos-p9's 0.067 improvement where a restart produced nothing.
resume_rule: resume from the parent BEST checkpoint on both resume slots, hash-verified before a weight is loaded.
closure_tolerance_note: Declared 2026-08-05. Every segment in this campaign uses the energy-scaled closure tolerance, so segments here are not directly comparable to runs frozen before that change. See audit/closure_tolerance_20260805_terminal_analysis.json.

calibrated_lr3e4.note: the best result in the project. Its dicos-p7 segment improved only 0.008346, inside the ~0.02 run-to-run resolution, so it had effectively plateaued over six epochs -- but it has had only 23 epochs against lr1e4's 39, which is what this campaign tests.

calibrated_lr1e4_halfbatch.note: best epoch 21 while its last epoch is 22, so the parent_last_epoch here is the BEST epoch, which is what the resume actually continues from.

calibrated_lr3e5.note: the least-trained family, 8 epochs, and last on absolute loss. Most headroom, weakest prior.

excluded.calibrated_lr1e4: not in the chain by the owner's instruction. It has had 39 epochs, the most of any family, and its dicos-p10 epoch-40 checkpoint is ARTIFACT QUARANTINED and is not a valid parent.
